balls.text: low full toss and he swings him down to long-on, didn't time it and Kings XI have posted a competitive 170
slower ball and he thumps it down to cover
goes for the drive and he gets an outside edge that lobs off the keeper's gloves and drops in front of short third man
expensive over already, slower ball tossed up outside off, he whacks that leg cutter several rows over long-on
good improvisation! On the pads and he gets on his knee and sweeps hard and finds the big gap at deep square leg
slower ball and Miller swings and misses, the keeper is up to the stumps
even White drops them! Chargers and their catching bug, he hammers a length ball flat and fast down to long-off, White sprinted to his left and couldn't hang on
swings and misses, slower ball and he played too early, misses the off stump
makes room and jams out a full delivery to the off side
full on the pads and worked down to fine leg, Veer Pratap misfields
jams it down to cover and he completes a quick single
Theron bowls the slower bouncer and Miller controls the pull well, maintains his balance and keeps it along the ground down to deep square leg
on the pads and worked down to midwicket
works it down to long-on where Jhunjhunwala picks up and throws quickly
fullish on the off stump and driven down to long-off
fullish on the pads and worked down to wide long-on
gives him a bit of width and he stays at the crease and hammers that wide of cover, beats everyone
keeps low and he chops it to the off side

embarassing mixup there! Mahmood slammed it towards Reddy at point and he was ball-watching, Miller was already miles out of his crease and wanted the run straightaway, Mahmood had no time to beat the throw to the bowler, he was well short
full and wide outside off and bashed down to long-off
opens the face and gently steers it down to third man
slower ball and Miller chips it to the vacant midwicket region
punched straight to cover,another dot ball
steers it softly to the off side and thinks of a single
this was the short he was attempting the previous ball, short and wide and he slaps that wide of point and there's nobody there to cut it off
keeps low again as he tries to cut, misses it
stays back at the crease and clips it to midwicket
no century  for Mandeep! But a memorable innings, Reddy bowls the slow leg cutter, Mandeep has a big slog and fails to make contact, off stump pegged back
tries to steer it with soft hands to the off side but the ball bounces and lobs behind the keeper
comes forward and drives him down to cover
elegance again! Length delivery on the off stump and he scoops it over the bowler's head
stays back at the crease and chops it to cover
terrific shot! He picks a length delivery on middle and off and slams it elegantly down to fine leg, maintained his balance well, wristy flick
makes room and tries to slam that over mid-off but fails to make any contact, Parthiv appeals but that was far from the bat
bowls it short again and he mistimes it to deep midwicket
tries to slam it across the line but mistimes it to long-on
not much width but he opens the face and dabs it down to third man, very effectively done by Mahmood
gets on his knee and he lofts him down to long-on
makes room and tries to chop it to the off side, he fails to make contact
whipped down to midwicket, they take a quick single and the throw is to the bowler, he whips the bails and Mahmood is safe
drifts on the pads and he whips it down to deep square leg
makes room and slaps a length delivery down to deep cover
punches a flatter delivery down to long-on
makes room and steers it down to point and thinks of a single
pushed flatter and quicker and defended back to the bowler
makes room and steers a length delivery to deep point
Mishra's nightmare continues, he once again drops it too short, Mandeep makes a lot of room and whacks it across the line and clears midwicket again
drops it short and he picks a length delivery and clubs that over midwicket, had to be spanked
Soft dismissal for Hussey, he tried to launch a length delivery over long-off, mistimed it and Harris caught it comfortably well in front of the rope
fullish on the off stump and he gives the charge and scoops it to the vacant mid-off region
comes down the track and mistimes the shot down to midwicket
much better, pitched up further and straightens, big drive but misses it completely
big swing and a miss, could have been the slower one outside off
almost a repeat of the previous boundary, Hussey lofts a pitched up delivery and comfortably clears cover
spoils a good over, leans forward to a wide delivery and lofts him inside out over cover, beats the fielder at the deep
breaks the sequence of dots by pounding this down to long-on
drifts on the pads and the ball dribbles to the on side
fullish and driven down to mid-off
thumped hard to the off side
slashed and well fielded by Jhunjhunwala at point, saved at least a couple
angles towards the body and he whips it in the air and midwicket leaps to his right and tries to pull off a blinder
Mandeep pushes it down to cover
Mandeep was a few paces down and he thumped a length ball over mid-off and cover, exploited the big gap there
stays at the crease and pokes it down to square third man
keeps it short and he slashes it down to deep point
short and wide and he thumps it down to deep point
chips down the track and drives him to cover
goes back and clips him down to deep midwicket
plonks forward and defends
eased it down to long-off
pushed it down to cover
shot of the evening so far, tossed up outside off and he nonchalantly lofts him cleanly over wide long-off, not the best start for Mishra
poor delivery, short ball outside off, the slower delivery didn't land in the right spot, he clubbed that over wide long-on
pushes it down to long-off
fires it wide down the leg side, beats the keeper

that didn't look very convincing to the honest, Reddy bowled the leg cutter, Saini was rooted to the crease as he tried to whip it away, the ball hits his pads but appeared to be missing leg, you could see all three stumps, however, Dharmasena was convinced
steered towards point and there was a fumble, the batsman was out of his crease but the fielding wasn't sharp enough
inside edge to midwicket
chance! Mandeep spooned it to the bowler's left and he dived but couldn't get his hands behind it
bowls it flatter and he gets a leading edge to cover, nearly a run-out at the batsman's end but he dives
off the pads! Dhawan bowls that flatter and drifting towards the leg stump, Marsh used his feet and nearly yorked himself, the ball clipped the pad and hit the base of the stumps
gets well forward and drives him down to mid-on
gets forward and drives him down to long-on
goes back and drives to deep extra cover for a couple
tries to cut that but misses, the ball skidded through
enterprising shot but for no run, gets on his knee and fetches it from the off stump sweeps that straight to short fine leg
that beats the outside edge, keeps a bit low as well and bounces before reaching the keeper
angles across him and he dabs it down to third man
he fetches a length delivery from outside off and hammers that wide of the bowler and mid-on, brings up the 50
short and wide and he spanks that wide of backward point, just beats the dive and races away
turned towards midwicket, confusion in the running and Mandeep turns back and makes his ground before the keeper takes off the bails
goes right across the stumps and exposes all three of them on the sweep, the ball hits the boot and that looked quite close, the ball rolls to the leg side
slashed and brilliant stop by Daniel Harris at point sliding to his left
boundary ball but Marsh ended up chopping it towards the keeper, full and wide and should have been out away
tossed up on the off stump and clipped towards midwicket
gets beside the line and steers it towards point
slower ball but honing in on a yorker length, he digs it out to square leg
full and swinging away late and he clips it to the on side
comes forward and pushes it down to cover
gets forward and drives towards cover
that was a low full toss angling across him and Marsh got forward and sliced it wide of the diving point fielder, nice timing
gets forward and tucks it softly to the on side
that's well played, flat and wide, he makes a bit of room and slices it down to third man, the fielder was within the circle
gets forward and drives him down to cover
bowls this one flatter and he makes room and cuts to point
clips it with the turn down to square leg for a single
down the track and he forces it to mid-on
good way to end a horror over, pitched up and nipping back in and the ball snuck past the inside edge on the drive
this one more on target, nipped back in and hits him on the pads
the over gets worse, full and wide again and Mandeep launched that over extra cover off the front foot
full and wide outside off and he reached out and scooped it over extra cover, Marsh wanted three but he was sent back, Marsh was in trouble
too short and wide outside off, Mandeep had to stretch and he couldn't reach
that was a short one that fizzed off the pitch, Mandeep couldn't pull that, down the leg side though
he isn't learning from his mistake, too short and at a gentle pace, wide as well and Mandeep slapped that over deep backward point
he bangs it in short, the length was perfect for Mandeep to club it over midwicket, poor ball
gives it more air and Marsh thuds it back to the bowler
clips it with the turn down to long-on
he bowls it flat and too short and he mistimes the pull to deep midwicket, there's protection there
fuller delivery on middle and worked down to mid-on for a quick single
steers it away with the turn to point
bowls it flat and quick, he picks the fuller delivery from outside off and forces it to mid-on
a short ball is pulled towards midwicket, and that's that, Punjab have won on the road once more, Deccan have lost at home again, a 25-run win this for Punjab, they move up to 12 points now
a terrific stroke that, not much help for Chargers, that was overpitched and was driven towards sweeper cover for four
short of length and that is pulled to midwicket for a single
slower ball, back of the hand variety, pitched up and that is swung towards fine leg
looks to swipe this towards midwicket, edges it to the off side instead for a single
back of a length and outside off, tapped to the leg side for a single
length ball is slammed towards deep midwicket for four, 35 needed off the final over
short of length and angling in, awkwardly fended towards midwicket
slower ball from Awana, on a length and heading for leg stump, pushed towards point
overpitched and that is driven towards mid-off for a single
short of length delivery, Reddy goes for the pull, hit high on the bat and it loops towards Marsh at square leg, Chargers are eight down, will they be bowled out?
a big swipe and a miss, but Chargers still get four, that was angling in and angles past the leg stump after beating the batsman, and swings further away to beat the keeper
Praveen fires it in full, dug out towards mid-off
sent to long-on for a single
another short ball, not as short as the previous one though, Reddy muscles this to midwicket for four
a bouncer to test Reddy, he can't connect

a high full toss as he looks to follow the batsman, miscued it towards mid-off, not the best bit of running from Jhunjhunwala, he was almost jogging there, seemingly sure of making it, but a rifle throw from Marsh at mid-off catches him out by a couple of yards, that was shambolic from Jhunjhunwala, possibly the worst bit of cricket this season
length ball outside off, carved towards deep point for a single
fuller and flatter, on middle stump, driven towards long-off for a single
shorter and outside off, the conventional legbreak, slapped towards backward point
Ashish Reddy gets going with a clip to square leg

quicker and outside off, Reddy charged down the track and he is beaten by the change of pace, Saini doesn't have much time to take off the bails, but he does before Reddy gets the back leg in, Saini's had a good game despite that shocker of an lbw decision when batting
pitched up and that is hammered over long-on, a clean swing of the bat sends the ball sailing near the sightscreen
skids straight on outside off, steered to short third man for a single
slower ball, only 91.5kph that, shortish and it is slammed towards midwicket for four more, ten off the over but they need a lot more
short of length and angling in towards off, pushed towards sweeper cover off the front foot
follows the batsman who was backing away, inside-edged on to the pads
a bouncer, Reddy looks to pull but is late, a top-edge over the keeper for four
driven towards long-on for a single

120kph delivery that barely got above boot high, that one angles past the bat and just past leg stump, as if the asking rate wasn't high enough, the difficult pitch makes it almost impossible for Chargers
fired in towards the blockhole, squeezed out towards the leg side for a single
just outside off, Jhunjhunwala was down the track looking to slice that one, he's beaten
shortish and outside off, flat-batted towards mid-on
slower ball, stays low as he angles it towards legstump, Jhunjhunwala adjusts and defends towards point
short of length and just outside off, powered towards Hussey at mid-off
another bit of luck for Reddy, a leading edge as he looks to power the ball, which flies towards wide long-off
short of length ball down the leg side, that's a wide, Awana thought there was a glove, he went up in appeal, and he's right, there was a glove, Reddy survives
a length ball is dispatched over deep midwicket for six, Deccan need more of those from Jhunjhunwala, the asking rate is more than 13
flighted and on a length, once more Reddy comes down the track, drives it towards long-on
full again, outside off this time, swiped towards midwicket
overpitched and the batsman charges down the ground and drills the ball towards long-on
length ball very wide outside off, the batsman reaches across and slaps it towards mid-off
overpitched and outside off, whipped towards long-on
a mistimed drive, the ball dribbles towards the bowler
helped towards deep square leg for a single
the famous Chawla googly, batsman looks to drive and that takes the inside-edge past the keeper, Ramesh Powar goes full steam after it, and manages to keep them to three
short and wide, should have capitalised on that one, instead he slices it to backward point
on middle stump, clipped towards midwicket
slashed towards sweeper cover for a single
pushed towards extra cover for a single this time
stays low this time, and the batsman can't get bat on it outside off
the inward movement causing more trouble for Jhunjhunwala, between bat and pad as he looks to slice it towards cover
not the most confident of starts from Jhunjhunwala, inside-edged onto the pads

what a catch from Saini, Sangakkara is gone and Chargers are imploding, once again their home stadium isn't proving a happy hunting ground, that one seamed after after pitching on off, does enough to get the outside edge, Saina has a bit of ground to cover to take that, he throws out his left arm and it sticks
short of length and outside off, Sangakkara guides that towards third man for a single
worked off the pads to the leg side, just two off that over, and two key wickets
defended back towards the bowler

Hussey had turned this game around, he gets the danger man Cameron White, this wasn't his usual flat and fast delivery, slight bit of air, White sees it and wants to send that out of the park, he gets too much height on it, it's in the air a long time, Shaun Marsh settled under it at deep midwicket, he didn't make a mistake, and Punjab are on top now
tucked towards midwicket for a single
full ball is defended by Sangakkara

Hussey strikes first ball! pitched up and outside off, Harris looks to power it over extra cover, off the outside edge and towards backward point for an easy catch, why doesn't Hussey bowl more often, he did a decent job in the CB series as well
another big appeal for lbw, this time White was well forward as he looked to defend a length ball, looked to have been struck outside off
a bouncer from Mahmood, 128 kph this time, White went for the pull but he can't connect
pitched up, pushed towards long-on for one more
outside off this time, guided down towards third man for a single
loud appeal for lbw but that was heading down the leg side, that one jagged in sharply, that struck him above the knee roll in front of middle and leg but was slanting down
slants it in from wide of the crease, a length ball is blocked to the leg side
surprised by the extra bounce there, short of length ball just outside off, Harris takes the bottom hand off the bat as he hastily takes the bat out of the line of that one
seams in sharply, 137kph, that was shortish and outside off, White guides it towards third man
back of a length once more, White is pinned on the back foot, defended down the track
pitched up this time, heading for off, slower ball 106kph, driven towards mid-off for a single
short of length again, plenty of width this time, slapped past point by Harris
Awana starts the over with a short of length ball just outside off, defended towards the bowler
full delivery is punched towards long-on for a single
nudged towards square leg for a single
flighted and that is chopped towards sweeper cover

some terrible cricket all around, a high full toss from Powar, Harris could have slammed that anywhere he wanted, he chooses midwicket but Chawla is there, he runs to his left and gets his hands on it but drops it, and lets it run away for four as well, Chawla should have taken that
length ball spinning in, Harris works it to sweeper cover, and zips through for two
pitching outside off, Harris get on his knee and slams that towards midwicket, that didn't rise too much either

the over starts and ends with a boundary, this time it is White, he really doesn't need to be trying unconventional hits like the previous paddle when he can hit the ball as sweetly as he did there, muscles it over extra cover for a four
length ball pitching well outside off, White stretches across and looks to paddle it towards short fine, can't connect and is hit on the body
overpitched and that was flighted, Harris lofts it inside-out towards sweeper cover for a single
blocked off the front foot
defended towards point by Harris
Harris growing in confidence after the struggles early on, an overpitched ball is launched over long-off for six, "just what the doctor ordered," says the giant screen
driven firmly back towards the bowler, Mahmood gets his boot in the way of that to stop the ball
short of length and outside off, driven towards mid-off off the front foot
pushed it in full, squeezed towards midwicket for a single
another short ball, just outside off, White looks to defend it initially, then withdraws his bat
a 136kph bouncer, White gets out of the line of that, too high for the umpire's liking
a quick single is taken,Harris pokes the ball to point where a misfield allows the run
pitched up on middle, defended off the front foot
that's a poor delivery to start, Mahmood starts with a delivery sliding way down the leg side
great comeback from Awana, gets Parthiv bowled, that was short of a length and stayed lower than Parthiv expected, he didn't move his feet at all as he attempted to work it to the leg side
short ball from Awana, Parthiv latches on to that, it was on leg stump and Parthiv loves the pull, he sends this over the deep backward square leg boundary for six
slower offcutter from Awana, pushed towards cover
Awana pushes it to 142 kph, short of length ball and Parthiv looks to whip it to the leg side, it stays lower than he expects, but not low enough to crash into off stump, just sails over
angling across, shortish 134 kph, Parthiv looks to scythe that through point, but misses
short ball, sits up for Parthiv who pulls it firmly towards deep backward square leg, Powar didn't have much of a chance at fine leg
Parthiv punches the last ball of the over towards mid-on and scampers a single
Harris is struggling out there, another booming shot attempted, misses, on to the pads and the ball rolls towards square leg
another outswinger from Praveen, pushed towards cover by Parthiv
fuller from Praveen this time, Harris looks to send that into orbit, or at least beyond midwicket, inside-edged towards square leg
short of length and outside off, slapped hard towards point
Parthiv pushes an outswinger from Praveen towards cover, bit of a misfield there, gives way one
a length ball is sent towards midwicket this time
pitched up and on the pads, worked to deep midwicket for two

that was very tight run-out chance! Harris punches the ball towards mid-off, and sets off for a single, reaches at a nice height for Hussey who fires in the throw but misses, a dive from Harris helps him make his ground, only by a frame though
opens the face to guide the ball towards backward point, Harris wants one, Parthiv doesn't
short and that also stays low, not low enough to fool Parthiv, who pulls it off the back foot towards midwicket
defended towards midwicket for a single
length ball on off stump, defended from the crease by Parthiv Patel

Praveen gets the ball to move away a touch, Dhawan reaches for that and ends up edging it to a very wide first slip, the field placement has worked for Punjab, Dhawan has scored lots of runs this season, this is a big wicket
inside-edge towards backward square leg for a single
this one seams away after pitching just outside off, Harris wanted to steer that behind point but is beaten
short of a length and on off stump, tipped towards point by Harris who then screams, 'Wait in'
Praveen's first ball is chopped towards point for a single
more controlled from Dhawan, sliced past extra cover and there's a better fielding effort this time, Shaun Marsh it is who puts in the slide at the boundary to cut that off

skips down the track and looks to launch that beyond the long-on boundary, he gets plenty of height on it, and the ball is in the air a long time, the fielders races back from mid-on, he can't reach there in time, and the ball just lands in front of him, and to make it worse, he was unbalanced by the attempt at the catch and let the ball through for four
defended to the leg side this time
hello! that stays very low, and spins away outside off, that was quite short from Powar but didn't rise above shin height, Dhawan beaten
pitched up and Harris has a swing at it, not too well timed as he sends it towards long-on
fires it in towards the pads, defended to the leg side
